title: Hand MoM's cards, preset and tokens to core without losing the design
description:
What: supply the reference material for Papyrus stories PPY-613a29 (core card set), PPY-cf7e6e (publication layout) and PPY-88a883 (brand pack): mom_components.py behaviour, the design system and the golden renders, then reduce MoM to a brand pack plus ornaments. MoM must stay unchanged visually. Threat Intelligence must run on the result without any change to MoM code (the neutrality acceptance test).
Acceptance:
Scenario: MoM is a brand pack plus ornaments
  Given MoM on the core preset
  Then web/hooks.py contains only ornament functions and the brand pack holds colours, fonts and logo
